sources.title: SARSA (State-Action-Reward-State-Action) in Reinforcement Learning
sources.snippet: SARSA (State-Action-Reward-State-Action) is an on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm that helps an agent to learn an optimal policy by interacting with its environment.

sources.title: SARSA Reinforcement Learning - Online Tutorials Library
sources.snippet: SARSA stands for State-Action-Reward-State-Action, which is a modified version of the Q-learning algorithm where the target policy is the same as the behavior policy. The two consecutive state-action pairs and the immediate reward received by the agent while transitioning from the first state to the next state determine the updated Q value, so this method is called SARSA. sources.title: On the Convergence of SARSA with Linear Function Approximation
sources.snippet: One possible solution is linear func-tion approximation, which approximates the action values via the inner product of state-action features and a learnable weight vector. The behavior of SARSA with linear function approximation (linear SARSA) is, however, less understood.
